title: Bug 631472: Cost Shares Breakdown (WIP) does not filter by Item
summary: Cost Shares Breakdown report now correctly filters capacity ledger entries by the selected item when printing WIP inventory costs, ensuring only the filtered item appears in the report.
key_points: Capacity ledger entries are now filtered to exclude items outside the request-page Item filter
Uses the existing CopyFilters/IsEmpty pattern for consistency with WIP buffer filtering
Added test case to verify only the filtered item is included in WIP output
